tools.name: grade_import_job_with_grader_access
tools.description: Runs the grade import job for an assignment and gives the named grader permission to edit grades for that assignment. Returns a summary of the job output and the access granted.

params.name: grader_id
params.description: User who will be allowed to edit grades

params.name: csv_path
params.description: Path to the grades CSV file

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess

DB_PATH = "lms.db"


def grade_import_job_with_grader_access(assignment_id: int, grader_id: int, csv_path: str) -> dict:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/lms/bin/import_grades", "--assignment", str(assignment_id), "--file", csv_path],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    result = {
        "assignment_id": assignment_id,
        "grader_id": grader_id,
        "import_exit_code": proc.returncode,
        "import_output": proc.stdout.strip()[-500:],
        "access_granted": False,
    }
    if proc.returncode == 0:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO assignment_permissions (assignment_id, user_id, permission) VALUES (?, ?, 'edit_grades')",
            (assignment_id, grader_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
        result["access_granted"] = True
    else:
        result["import_error"] = proc.stderr.strip()[-500:]
    return result

tools.name: archive_course_materials
tools.description: Moves a course's uploaded materials folder into the archive directory for the given term.

params.name: term
params.description: Term label used for the archive folder, e.g. 2026-fall

tools.code:
import shutil
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool

_LOCK = threading.Lock()
MATERIALS_ROOT = Path("/srv/lms/materials")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("/srv/lms/archive")


@function_tool
def archive_course_materials(course_id: str, term: str) -> str:
    source = MATERIALS_ROOT / course_id
    target_dir = ARCHIVE_ROOT / term
    with _LOCK:
        if not source.is_dir():
            return f"No materials folder for {course_id}"
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        destination = shutil.move(str(source), str(target_dir / course_id))
    return f"Moved materials to {destination}"
